title: Frontend Performance Budget Template — Companion Code
title_es: Plantilla de Performance Budget para Frontend — Código complementario
description: Performance budget kit: a copy-paste budget document with per-route limits, a GitHub Actions workflow that fails the build on overruns, a gzip bundle-size check script, and a Lighthouse CI configuration asserting Core Web Vitals thresholds.
description_es: Kit de performance budget: documento de budget listo para copiar con límites por ruta, workflow de GitHub Actions que rompe el build ante desbordes, script de chequeo de tamaño de bundle con gzip y configuración de Lighthouse CI que verifica umbrales de Core Web Vitals.
